website_published.help: A code server action can be executed from the website, using a dedicated controller. The address is <base>/website/action/<website_path>. Set this field as True to allow users to run this action. If it is set to False the action cannot be run through the website.

xml_id.help: ID of the action if defined in a XML file

website_form_default_field_id.help: Specify the field which will contain meta and custom form fields datas.

website_form_label.help: Form action label. Ex: crm.lead could be 'Send an e-mail' and project.issue could be 'Create an Issue'.

website_form_blacklisted.help: Blacklist this field for web forms

first_page_id.help: First page linked to this view

record_domain.help: Domain to restrict records that can be viewed publicly

group_ids.help: User needs to be at least in one of these groups to see the menu

is_new_page_template.help: Add this page to the "+New" page templates. It will be added to the "Custom" category.

website_url.help: The full URL to access the document through the website.

redirect_type.help:
Type of redirect/Rewrite:

        301 Moved permanently: The browser will keep in cache the new url.
        302 Moved temporarily: The browser will not keep in cache the new url and ask again the next time the new url.
        404 Not Found: If you want remove a specific page/controller (e.g. Ecommerce is installed, but you don't want /shop on a specific website)
        308 Redirect / Rewrite: If you want rename a controller with a new url. (Eg: /shop -> /garden - Both url will be accessible but /shop will automatically be redirected to /garden)

field_names.help: A list of comma-separated field names

limit.help: The limit is the maximum number of records retrieved

is_connected.help: A visitor is considered as connected if his last page view was within the last 5 minutes.

lang_id.help: Language from the website when visitor has been created

page_count.help: Total number of tracked page visited

partner_id.help: Partner of the last logged in user.

time_since_last_action.help: Time since last page view. E.g.: 2 minutes ago

visit_count.help: A new visit is considered if last connection was more than 8 hours ago.

visitor_page_count.help: Total number of visits on tracked pages
